name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source API development platform for REST, GraphQL and WebSocket requests, with team workspaces and an admin dashboard, backed by PostgreSQL.

alerts.message: Open /admin right after deploying: the first account to sign in there becomes the administrator. The onboarding needs at least one sign-in method, either GitHub, Google or Microsoft OAuth credentials, or an SMTP server for email magic links. Register OAuth apps with the callback URL https://<your-domain>/backend/v1/auth/<provider>/callback (github, google or microsoft).
